picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest node in DOE's new Genesis Mission, signaling where the government is placing its biggest bets on AI-for-science infrastructure.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: ORNL leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 others cements Oak Ridge's position as a top-tier hub for AI-driven scientific computing, alongside Berkeley and Sandia.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's selection to lead six projects and partner on 17 more shows the Genesis Mission spreading deeply across the national lab system, not just concentrating at a handful of flagship sites.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: NASA joining a whole-of-government initiative launched by executive order, alongside 15+ federal agencies, marks the Genesis Mission as a durable national AI policy priority rather than a single-agency program.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: An on-record NSF leadership statement tying the agency's mission directly to the administration's AI priorities signals sustained federal policy commitment behind the hundreds of Genesis Mission university and lab awards this week.
picks.title: Statement from NSF Chief of Staff Brian Stone, performing the duties of the NSF director, on advancing the Administration's AI priorities through the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation for an AI materials-discovery startup co-led by an Imperial College scientist shows academic AI research translating directly into major private capital.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS releasing an updated fully open, multimodal large language model trained on a national supercomputer is a rare instance of a serious open alternative to closed frontier labs.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT deepening their AI/robotics partnership with government-backed funding and reciprocal faculty exchanges strengthens a major transatlantic research pipeline in physical AI.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: A new deep-learning model revealing how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients is a concrete scientific advance from AI applied to biomedicine, independent of the Genesis Mission funding wave.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's launch of a program to build generative AI foundation models and autonomous research agents for science represents a major international counterpart to the U.S. Genesis Mission effort.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)
